source.title: State Holiday Schedule for Fiscal Year 2027 (Texas State Auditor's Office); also Comptroller 'State of Texas Holiday Schedule, Fiscal Year 2027' https://comptroller.texas.gov/about/holidays.php; Tex. Gov't Code ch. 662

weekendRule: none: a holiday that falls on a Saturday or Sunday is not observed on another day

weekendShift.satNote: Texas does not move weekend holidays to a weekday
weekendShift.sunNote: Texas does not move weekend holidays to a weekday

additionalSources.title: Texas Government Code ch. 662 (holidays not moved when on a weekend)

excludedConfederateHolidays.name: Confederate Heroes Day (skeleton-crew state holiday: offices stay open; Tue Jan 19, 2027; when it coincides with MLK Day only one holiday is observed, as in 2026)

federal.name: Independence Day
federal.closureNote: Falls on a Saturday: Texas does not move weekend holidays to a weekday.

stateHolidays.name: Day after Thanksgiving
stateHolidays.note: 'All agencies closed' on FY2026 and FY2027 Auditor schedules.

stateHolidays.name: Christmas Eve
stateHolidays.note: 'All agencies closed' on FY2026 and FY2027 schedules; only when it falls on a weekday (no weekend shift).

stateHolidays.name: Day after Christmas
stateHolidays.closureNote: Falls on a Saturday: Texas does not move weekend holidays to a weekday.
stateHolidays.note: 'All agencies closed' on the FY2026 schedule (Fri Dec 26, 2025); in FY2027 Dec 26, 2026 is a Saturday so it is not observed. Counts only in years it falls on a weekday.

partialOrLocal.name: Emancipation Day in Texas (Juneteenth)
partialOrLocal.note: State holiday with skeleton crew required (FY2026: 'Skeleton crew required'); offices stay open. Falls on Sat in 2027 so not observed. Employees who work get comp time.

partialOrLocal.name: Texas Independence Day
partialOrLocal.note: Skeleton crew required (Tue Mar 2, 2027); offices stay open.

partialOrLocal.name: San Jacinto Day
partialOrLocal.note: Skeleton crew required (Wed Apr 21, 2027); offices stay open.

partialOrLocal.name: Lyndon Baines Johnson Day
partialOrLocal.note: Skeleton crew required (Fri Aug 27, 2027); offices stay open.

partialOrLocal.name: Good Friday
partialOrLocal.note: Optional holiday (Gov't Code 662.003(c)): an employee may observe it in lieu of a skeleton-crew state holiday (Mar 26, 2027).

partialOrLocal.name: Cesar Chavez Day
partialOrLocal.note: Optional holiday (Gov't Code 662.013), listed on the FY2026/FY2027 Auditor schedules (Wed Mar 31, 2027); same in-lieu-of-skeleton-crew-day mechanism.

partialOrLocal.name: Rosh Hashanah
